ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Venus

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.
